clips.title: The story
paras: Deep in the Deadmines, Sneed's Shredder cuts timber and guards the works. Goblin taskmaster Sneed pilots the machine for Edwin VanCleef's shipwrights, turning its blades against intruders.

In the Deadmines foundry, goblin shredders cut timber for Edwin VanCleef's hidden juggernaut. They also meet intruders with armored force. Sneed oversees the lumber works and pilots this modified machine himself, wielding its oversized buzzsaw as a weapon of defense.

Sneed rides above the spinning blades in an open cockpit, protected by heavy iron plating. The machine's clatter can scatter his foes. When the shredder breaks down and collapses in sparks, Sneed leaps from the wreckage and fights on.
